verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל׃
verses.en: If one venture a word unto thee, wilt thou be weary? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.he: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק׃
verses.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

verses.he: כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃
verses.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.he: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה׀ תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃
verses.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou art weary; It toucheth thee, and thou art affrighted.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Is not thy fear of God thy confidence, And thy hope the integrity of thy ways?

verses.he: זְכָר־נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.en: According as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow mischief, reap the same.

verses.he: מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣וֹ יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.en: By the breath of God they perish, And by the blast of His anger are they consumed.

verses.he: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ׃
verses.en: The lion roareth, and the fierce lion howleth— Yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.

verses.he: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי־טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the whelps of the lioness are scattered abroad.

verses.he: וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
verses.en: Now a word was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a whisper thereof.

verses.he: בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל־אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,

verses.he: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד׃
verses.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, And all my bones were made to shake. .

verses.he: וְ֭רוּחַ עַל־פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.en: Then a spirit passed before my face, That made the hair of my flesh to stand up.

verses.he: יַעֲמֹ֤ד׀ וְֽלֹא־אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the appearance thereof; A form was before mine eyes; I heard a still voice:

verses.he: הַֽ֭אֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱל֣וֹהַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר־גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.en: ’Shall mortal man be just before God? Shall a man be pure before his Maker?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה׃
verses.en: Behold, He putteth no trust in His servants, And His angels He chargeth with folly;

verses.he: אַ֤ף׀ שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי־חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר־בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי־עָֽשׁ׃
verses.en: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

verses.he: מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.en: Betwixt morning and evening they are shattered; They perish for ever without any regarding it.

verses.he: הֲלֹא־נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
